body.purpose: Short supporting agency copy; long-form detail copy uses a separate reading size.

shadows.name: mobile-navigation
shadows.purpose: Separates the open mobile menu from the hero; cards remain flat.

motion.name: hero-orbit
motion.value: requestAnimationFrame; up to 80 SVG units of radial spike extension
motion.purpose: Hovered individual spikes grow longer outward along their existing direction. No lateral bending. Inner anchors and SVG position stay fixed; static for reduced motion.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: animation: none !important; transition: none !important; scroll-behavior: auto
motion.purpose: Static composition and immediate navigation when reduced motion is requested.

components.name: Shared Primary Button
components.description: Flat filled pill control; white secondary variant; circular icon controls and no diagonal button icons.

components.name: Service Disclosure
components.description: Native expandable service row with aligned heading/content and up/down chevrons.
components.html:
Brand Identity

A clear visual identity, thoughtfully made for your business.

narrative.overview: The supplied MOTIVE 9 desktop PDF is the visual authority. Oversized yellow type, a white gridded hero, radial geometry, a yellow discipline ribbon, alternating charcoal and white sections, and a yellow closing panel define the implemented world. This records the incumbent reference-pinned direction without introducing a new aesthetic.
keyCharacteristics: Flat filled controls and rounded artwork wrappers

rules.name: The Reference Palette Rule
rules.body: Preserve the yellow/charcoal/white section rhythm and derive geometric artwork from those colors.

rules.name: The Oversized Type Rule
rules.body: Preserve the large wordmark and compact headline tracking across responsive sizes.

dos: Do follow the supplied reference composition.
Do use the actual fluid gutter and responsive grids.
Do retain visible focus and native disclosure.
Do disable animation and transitions for reduced motion.
donts: Don't introduce a replacement palette or type pairing.
Don't add fictitious clients, metrics, awards, or people.
Don't add ambient card shadows or content that depends on animation.
